Use case stylized-concept. Make a GAME SPRITE ATLAS, transparent background, exactly 5 columns by 2 rows of equal cells. 1536x1024 total. Ten isolated small objects, each centered inside its own cell with generous transparent padding, consistent eye-level frontal/slightly above perspective to sit on a workbench. Match warm worn space-station watercolor on fibrous rice paper: subdued ochre sage charcoal faded dusty brick, detailed pencil lines and weathered ink, textured pigment, very low saturation and medium-dark tones. No outlined cartoon look. Each object occupies approximately 65% width and 70% height of cell, base aligned to 83% of cell height. NO grid lines labels or text; truly transparent gaps and background. Exact row-major order: TOP ROW cell1 a worn dusty red rectangular emergency battery with two metal terminals and tiny old cream lightning marking; cell2 a visually near-identical worn dusty red battery; cell3 old compact sage green coffee machine with small pot; cell4 sealed beige space ration pouch with faded green emblem; cell5 folded cream star navigation paper chart lying almost flat. BOTTOM ROW cell1 a small standing weathered wooden photo frame with tiny indistinct family portrait; cell2 small living leafy plant in brown clay pot; cell3 a very similar artificial leafy plant in weathered muted grey pot; cell4 small beige plush astronaut doll sitting down; cell5 small old green computer memory circuit module. No extra objects. All ten complete silhouettes, no overlap, no cut off edges. These will be placed in cluttered watercolor rooms and must subtly blend with their environment, no glow, no drop shadow beyond tiny contact wash.
